entries.german:
1371. 14. September. Krumau. — Peter, Ulrich und Johann von Rosenberg schenken in Vollziehung des letzten Willens ihres Bruders Jodok dem Abte und Convente des Klosters in Hohenfurt das Dorf Konradschlag.

CXXXVI. In nomine domini amen. Pristine ac moderne etatissagaciter adin- uenit prouidencia circumspecta, actus mortalium firmare litterarum apicibus, ne ipsos per decursum temporis obliuionis caligo fuscaret. Igitur nos Petrus Vlricus et Johannes fratres de Rosemberch notum facimus vniuersis, quod quia felicis recordii dilectus frater noster olim 152 dominus Jodocus de Rosemberch zelo deuocionis ac pietatis compunc- tus sanus mente et compos rationis existens ad diuini nominis gloriam et honorem, cuius altitudo prudencie nullis inclusa limitibus nullis terminis comprehensa suos cunelos ministros altis decorat honoribus et celestis efficit beatitudinis possessores, pro sue nee non suorum predecessorum animarum remedio vnam villam dictum in uulgari Theotonico Conratslag cum vniuersitate omnium et singulorum fruc- tuum reddituum ac prouentuum ad eam spectancium deuotis ac reli- giosis fratribus abbati et conuentui monasterii in Altouado Cistercien- sis ordinis, quod nostre fundacionis et dotacionis ab origine sua primeua fore dinoscitur, pie legauit contulit et donauit nomine testa- menti ¡dque nobis effectui mancipanJum commisit. Volentes ejusdem fratris nostri legata et commissa perducere ad effectum prelibatam villam cum omnibus ipsius adherenciis et circumfereuciis vniuersis iamdictis abbati et conuentui, qui est aut fuerit pro tempore, in per- petuum similiter pie damns concedimus et dunamus per ipsos et eorum successores dicti monasterii conuentus et abbates pro antedicti nostri fratris ac nostrorum predecessornm auimanim remedio possi- dendam, has tamen condiciones includendo, quod ipsi abbas et conu entus in perpetuum duos pauperes cum ¡His nouem, quos dudum in suo hospitali fouere noscuntur, a data presencium in antea et deinceps perpetuis futuris temporibus ibidem in ipsorum hospitali alere de- beant ac nutrire, necnou in die anniuersario memorati nostri fratris sexaginta pauperes cum pane et ceruisia pascere, cuilibet ipsorum per vnum denarium largiendo ceteraque omnia et singula, que in ce- lebracione anniuersariorum fundatorum solempnitates et cerimonia in cultu diuino et refeccione fratrum facere non negligant aut aliqua- liter pretermittant. In cuius rei testimonium ct robur sigilla nostra duximus presentibus appendenda. Datum Chrumpnaw anno domini millesimo trecentesimo septuagesimo primo in die exaltacionis sanete crusis. Über die an Pergamenfstreifen hängenden Siegel in rothem Wachs vergl. CIV. und CXIV. 153
entries.english:
1371, 14 September, Krumau. — Peter, Ulrich, and Hans von Rosenberg, in fulfillment of the last will of their brother Jodok, donate the village of Konradschlag to the abbot and convent of Hohenfurt Monastery.

CXXXVI. In the name of the Lord, amen. Prudent foresight has wisely devised in ancient and modern times that the acts of mortals be confirmed by written records, lest the darkness of forgetfulness obscure them in the course of time. Therefore we, Peter, Ulrich, and Johann, brothers von Rosemberch, make known to all that our beloved brother, of happy memory, the late Lord Jodocus von Rosemberch, moved by zeal for devotion and piety, while sound in mind and in full possession of reason, for the glory and honor of the divine name—whose wisdom's height is confined by no limits or bounds, who adorns his servants with lofty honors and makes them possessors of heavenly bliss—and for the remedy of his soul and those of his predecessors, piously bequeathed, granted, and donated by testament to the devout and religious brothers, the abbot and convent of the Cistercian monastery at Altovad, which from its very beginning is known to have been founded and endowed by us, one village called in the German vernacular Theotonico “Conratslag,” together with all and every one of its fruits, rents, and revenues. He entrusted its execution to us. Wishing to carry out our brother's bequests and commission, we likewise piously give, grant, and donate forever the aforesaid village, with all its appurtenances and surrounding lands, to the aforesaid abbot and convent, whoever may hold office at the time, to possess for them and their successors, for the remedy of the soul of our aforesaid brother and of our predecessors, on these conditions: the abbot and convent shall forever support and feed in their hospital two poor people in addition to the nine whom they are known to have long maintained there, from the date of this document onward for all future time; and on the anniversary of our aforesaid brother they shall feed sixty poor people with bread and beer, giving each one a denarius. They shall also not neglect or omit anything prescribed in the celebration of the anniversaries of the founders, in the solemnities and ceremonies of divine worship, and in the brothers' meals. In testimony and confirmation of this matter, we have caused our seals to be attached to this document. Given at Chrumpnaw in the year of the Lord 1371, on the feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross.

For the seals hanging from parchment strips in red wax, see CIII and CXIV.
